players.name: El Hadji Diouf
players.note: Played wide off the front rather than as an out-and-out striker at Liverpool, on either flank, and as a support forward at Bolton.

players.name: Clive Wilson
players.note: Attacking left-back and penalty taker at QPR.

players.name: John Barnes
players.note: FBref's DFFW is wrong: Barnes was one of England's great left wingers and never a defender. By these seasons he was drifting inside from the left into central midfield for Liverpool.

players.note: Blackburn used him at right-back and on the right of midfield; the wide role was the more frequent of the two.
